articles.title: Delhi HC allows Sun Pharma to manufacture, export its own weight loss drug
articles.summary: The Delhi High Court has permitted Sun Pharmaceutical Industries to manufacture and export its version of the diabetes and anti-obesity drug semaglutide from India. This decision comes amidst an ongoing patent infringement case, potentially boosting India's pharmaceutical manufacturing and export capabilities for critical medications, showcasing a key development in intellectual property and public health.

articles.title: US tells Thailand and Cambodia to stop fighting as clashes continue
articles.summary: The US has called on Thailand and Cambodia to immediately cease hostilities after three days of severe border clashes. The conflict has tragically claimed at least 10 lives and displaced hundreds of thousands of people, escalating humanitarian concerns. The US intervention underscores international efforts to de-escalate regional tensions and promote a peaceful resolution between the two Southeast Asian nations, crucial for stability.
